title: init+scout
goal:
Навигатор мы настроили, теперь давай по скиллам, начиная с init. просмотри насколько он эффективно работает, познакомься с harness, engine, routes из репозитория.
Для init создай синтетические eval cases - 5шт
каждый кейс - проект на отдельном стеке. Они все должны быть полностью разные.
нужно откалибровать сборку config.yaml, сбор rules, оптимизация scout (тоже перевести на haiku)
тк на scout завязан навигатор, его мы оставим на конец, сохранив результат на sonnet и сначала сравнивая с ним. Потом по ним уже сравним навигатора не стало ли хуже

phases.title: Init walkthrough: trace the skill steps (skills/init/SKILL.md, scaffold.mjs, config packs/validate CLI, scout agent, hand-off to the rules route through the engine), run init --auto once locally in a sandbox ($0 eval), record in STATE.md where turns and quality are lost.

Five init eval cases on fully different stacks, built through the existing case generator if it fits (change before add); expected config.yaml and rule drafts stored next to each case; deterministic graders; all cases load.

Sonnet baseline: run the five init cases x3 (scout on sonnet); save score, cost and turns per case in STATE.md and keep the scout artifacts (context + report) per case as the reference for the haiku-scout phase.
Calibrate config.yaml assembly: config graders improve over the sonnet baseline with no regression on other cases; targeted tests green.

Calibrate rules collection (drafts under .ambicode/policies/drafts in --auto): rule graders improve over the sonnet baseline with no regression; the manual/web rules path is logged as not covered by evals.
Cut init cost apart from scout from the baseline traces (redundant reads, turns): same or better score at lower cost per run.
Scout on haiku: compare with the saved sonnet scout reference (score, cost, context completeness); keep haiku only within the agreed tolerance, otherwise log the gap and the smallest fix.

Navigator on haiku-scout context: build the inseer-frontend context in a separate dir (backup .local-docs/context and current .ambicode/context untouched), run bench 6141 + 3571 + 6404 x3, then 10 cases x3, against haiku 932b65e4 (F1 .572); then npm run verify, version bump, STATE.md, commit.
